correctness.rationale: Cubical cells are unordered disjoint pairs of vertices/edges, counts (15,36,18). Its barycentric flag triangulation has (69,216,144) cells. Aut(K3,3)=(S3×S3)⋊C2 of order72; subgroup closure exhausts 112 distinct groups and 26 conjugacy classes. Dimension-preserving flags quotient without inversions; finite edge incidence, each vertex link path/circle, boundary components, signed triangle orientability and Euler characteristic classify quotient surfaces. Fresh independent implementation using all graph-class permutations and separate face/link/orientability algorithms reproduced all subgroup-size counts and seven-type histogram exactly. These finite categories are exhaustive because all 72 permutations, all subgroups, and all 144 flags were enumerated, not sampled.

value.rationale: A complete conjugacy/quotient homeomorphism census for the natural full symmetry of a classical graph-configuration surface is a useful finite classification: it distinguishes cyclic actions of the same order and determines boundary/orientability not accessible from nonequivariant homology.

final_claim: All 112 subgroups (26 conjugacy classes) of Aut(K3,3) yield seven and only seven ordinary quotient surface types of the unordered discretized two-particle cubical configuration surface, with counts 1 N5,2 N3,3 RP²,9 punctured Klein,36 Möbius,6 punctured torus,55 disk.
limitations: Underlying quotient surfaces only; orbifold isotropy, action on π1 and equivariant homeomorphism classification are not claimed.
